Demonstration only. All values are synthetic. Fire progression is an illustrative animation, not a validated fire model. This prototype does not determine whether conditions are safe for burning.
ABOUT THE PROTOTYPE

Oklahoma Grass Fire

A proposal demonstration of an hourly prescribed fire decision support platform for the state of Oklahoma.

The timeline contains 10 days of synthetic historical estimates and seven days of synthetic forecasts. Layer colors and site metrics demonstrate the intended interface; they do not represent real observations or forecasts.

The planner uses an illustrative wind-oriented ellipse clipped to a user-defined rectangle. It does not account for fuel continuity, terrain, suppression, spotting, or changing weather and is not a fire prediction.

A production system would require connected weather and fuel datasets, a validated fire modeling service, uncertainty assessment, and practitioner evaluation.
